comment: Very entertaining and easy to get along with. He acts like a kid but has a little bit of an ego that makes it hard to disagree with him in class. His grading is a little harsh and ambiguous.
GREAT CLASS! I loved this class. He is very hands on with his teaching and you will learn alot without even realizing it. Not too demanding, but really fulfilling.
Wonderful teacher.  The test were pretty hard, but he made the material interesting.

Dr. Hill is a great teacher! He keeps you thinking and on your feet with his sarcastic comments and jokes. His tests aren't easy though, and I was frusterated by the lack of guidance in terms of studying.
Pappy Starks is the best. Belize 2005, you guys kickass

Dr. Hill is a wonderful teacher. He genuinely cares about his students, and has an enthusiasm for the material which is contagious. He stimulates your critical thinking, and you can tell that he values and respects your input. His tests are fair and easy to prepare for. Great teacher and really fun!
